dict.string: HOS uses the camera only when you tap Open Camera to capture a photo for your local health context timeline. Photos stay on your iPhone.
HOS reads selected Health data you choose to share—such as steps, heart rate, energy, sleep, and glucose—to show a local personal context dashboard. HOS does not diagnose conditions.
HOS does not write health data in this MVP. This description is required by HealthKit capability configuration.
HOS reads your location only while the app is open, after you grant permission, to include an optional location snapshot in your local context. Location is not tracked in the background.
HOS records audio only when you press Start Recording, to measure microphone levels and store recordings locally on your iPhone. Audio is never uploaded.
HOS uses Motion & Fitness to detect activity state (sitting, walking, running, vehicle) and step metrics for your local dashboard.
